title: Tailwise Pharmacy Pharmacy-Placed Renewal: Days' Supply and Package Basis
content:
*Pharmacy dispensing basis.*

A pharmacy-placed Tailwise Pharmacy renewal asks for the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill, never more than the class's maximum days' supply per fill, in whole days, and carries the renewed prescription's packages per fill. The class maximum is the figure the fill-limits schedule sets for the prescription's class.

## Restated

| Element of the renewal | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Days' supply per fill | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill as written, held to the class maximum |
| Packages per fill | the renewed prescription's packages per fill, unchanged |

## Worked examples (hypothetical prescriptions)

- Rx Prescription Diet prescription written for 60 days, 2 bags per fill; class maximum 90 days. The renewal asks for 60 days, 2 bags per fill.
- A prescription written for 120 days in a class whose maximum is 90 days asks for 90 days; its packages per fill are carried over as written.
